canonical_statement: For a homogeneous discrete-time Markov transition kernel K on an arbitrary measurable state space and natural step counts m and n, the (m+n)-step transition kernel is K^n composed after K^m; equivalently, its value on every measurable set A is the integral of the n-step transition probability into A against the m-step transition law.
domain_and_universes: universe u; State : Type u; MeasurableSpace State; kappa : Kernel State State; IsMarkovKernel kappa; m n : Nat; Prop in Lean universe 0
conclusion: kappa ^ (m + n) = (kappa ^ n) composed after (kappa ^ m)
